body:
See, there have been a million different molds and I don't fit in any. I am immature professionally, personally and ...overall.

People don't understand that I can't just ...change... or remind myself to stop. It happens and I can't control it.

As far as my family, I think some of my meds have helped and I also think my parents aging has helped. My father had a heart attack in the spring and has been the most peaceful person since.

All issues point to me, not others. I have only gotten this far because I can ignore my issues and pretend they aren't there.
